offspring.name: cross-app-contract-builder-verifier
offspring.purpose: Use one contract-centered capability to plan and later verify an integration change in both repositories through native adapters; do not treat textual composition alone as proof.

tests.case: Frontend API contract change; map auth, typed client, local/cloud compatibility and action contract
Existing piece extension; map typed contract, auth, action wiring, version and lint/build

acceptance_gates: Both real SKILL.md parents fetched and provenance pinned
No unlicensed copying; original instructions summarized only
A single shared core must route to two native adapters
Each planned task includes a contribution from each parent, not superficial concatenation
Independent execution in both real apps required before a working-cross-app claim
No edits to third-party repositories without scoped authorization
